ModMetaData.name: Simple Monument Quest
ModMetaData.author: ZuoYao
ModMetaData.description:
原版纪念碑任务实在是太愚蠢了，所以我制作了这个mod，将占地庞大的建筑群改为了一个单体纪念碑！
内容： 纪念碑建筑占地1x1，所需材料和工作量按照任务要求重新计算。 完美继承任务原有的建造、保护和奖惩流程。 纪念碑血量按材料数量增加，与之前受损即失败不同，现在只有完全被摧毁才会导致任务失败！
———————— The original Monument quest was ridiculous, so I created this mod to change the massive complex into a single monument!
Content: The monument occupies a 1x1 area, and the required materials and labor have been recalculated according to the quest requirements. It perfectly inherits the original quest's construction, protection, and reward/penalty processes. The monument's health increases with the amount of materials used. Unlike before, where damage resulted in failure, now the quest only fails when the monument is completely destroyed!
